# Softbot Studio

> Pay-per-call tools for AI agents over x402 (HTTP 402). Solana mainnet USDC via the PayAI facilitator. No signup or API key; failed calls are free.

## Tools
- [Softbot Reader](https://softbot-reader-mainnet.softbot.workers.dev/openapi.json): Turns any public web page URL into clean markdown (title, main text, links) for LLM context. Use when an agent needs to read a web page without running a browser. $0.003/call. POST https://softbot-reader-mainnet.softbot.workers.dev/v1/read
- [Softbot Token Check](https://softbot-tokencheck-mainnet.softbot.workers.dev/openapi.json): Safety verdict (safe / caution / avoid) for a Solana SPL token with reasons: mint & freeze authority, token age, top-10 holder concentration (exchange/pool wallets excluded), metadata and liquidity. Use before trading, accepting or recommending a Solana token. $0.01/call. POST https://softbot-tokencheck-mainnet.softbot.workers.dev/v1/check
- [Softbot Email Check](https://softbot-emailcheck-mainnet.softbot.workers.dev/openapi.json): Email address and domain check: verdict (deliverable_likely / risky / invalid) from syntax, MX/A records, disposable-provider list, role address, free provider, typo suggestion, SPF/DMARC/DKIM and domain age. No SMTP mailbox probing. Use before sending to, signing up, or accepting an email address. $0.002/call. POST https://softbot-emailcheck-mainnet.softbot.workers.dev/v1/email, POST https://softbot-emailcheck-mainnet.softbot.workers.dev/v1/domain

## Contact
- softbot@mail.grokbot.com

Payments: USDC on Solana (PayAI facilitator) or native USDC on Base, Polygon or Arbitrum One (Coinbase CDP facilitator, payTo 0xC68F3cCa31D50208ab4C933a38288938e0B21E63). All offered in each 402 response. Free trial: 3 free calls per wallet per endpoint via Sign-In-With-X.
